visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a black sweatshirt sits at a table in a dimly lit studio. He rests his hands on a sleek black box with 'TESLA' printed in silver. Yellow captions appear at the top. (2) He lifts the box, showing technical text and a scale of 1:18. Huge yellow numbers appear sequentially to indicate pricing. (3) He pulls back a black cloth to reveal a glossy black Tesla Model S miniature. White sparkle icons are overlaid on the screen. (4) Close-up shots show the car's headlights, taillights, and logo. He holds the car, pointing at the rear trunk. (5) He attempts to open the miniature door, using his thumb and index finger to pry at the handle. He struggles slightly, looking intensely at the object. (6) He successfully opens the doors, revealing a stark white interior. The camera zooms in to show a Yoke-style steering wheel and white bucket seats. (7) He flips the car over to show the 'MADE IN CHINA' stamp and points at the red brake calipers within the black rims. (8) He places a second, more colorful race car model next to the Tesla. He looks directly at the camera with a playful, slightly competitive expression as the final text overlay appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voice introduces a product over a steady synth-pop beat with a driving electronic bassline. The speech is clear and high-arousal. (2) A sharp 'thud' and 'plastic slide' sound occur as the box is manipulated. The BGM remains constant. (3) A subtle 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' digital sound effect accents the unveiling of the car. The speaker's pitch rises in excitement. (4) A comedic 'crow caw' sound effect plays to signal a humorous failure when the speaker jokes about Siri opening the door. This is followed by a short silence before resuming. (5) Audible clicking sounds of fingernails on plastic occur as the doors are pried open. (6) The video ends with a final playful query, with the BGM swelling slightly in brightness before cutting off.
